Messages.Author: Frederick Scott
Messages.Body:
"Vehicle. The action to equip with this vehicle is at an additional +1 stealth...."

"6.1.3 Equip (+1 stealth)"
...
Third paragraph:
"To equip with an equipment card currently possessed by one of your other minions,
tap the acting minion (the minion who is attempting to get the equipment) and
announce the equipment card he is getting. More than one equipment card can be
taken from a minion in a single action..."

So if I equip with an Unlicensed Taxicab another minion already possesses, I assume
that it proffers its stealth bonus even if other equipment is also taken, correct?

I guess if one could equip with two Unlicensed Taxicabs (the vehicle restriction
not withstanding), it would be at +2 stealth for a total of 3 innate stealth to
the action. (This would be important if another card were printed with the bonus.)
Likewise, if another card had a -1 stealth penalty for equipping, if I moved it
and the Unlicensed Taxicab on the same equip action, the two would cancel each
other.

Fred
